summary: The ML Feature Store MVP unifies feature engineering across the enterprise, eliminating 60% duplicate code and reducing computation costs by 40%. Built on Feast, Redis, and Databricks, it provides versioned feature management, real-time serving, and secure access control. The solution accelerates ML development and ensures consistent training and inference performance, directly improving model reliability and reducing operational overhead.
scope_overview: The MVP delivers a centralized ML Feature Store featuring a versioned registry, batch Spark-based feature computation, real-time serving via Redis with <10ms latency, point-in-time correct training joins, drift monitoring, and secure team-level access using Unity Catalog. It integrates with Python SDK and REST API for seamless usage by data scientists and ML services.
key_risks: Latency under heavy concurrent load may exceed 10ms and impact inference SLAs.
Access control or metadata misconfigurations may expose sensitive data or features.
test_readiness: Test coverage exceeds 85% integration and 90% unit levels across SDK, API, Redis serving, and batch jobs. Load testing confirms near 10ms p99 latency. Security and access validations via Unity Catalog and OAuth2 completed. QA automation pipeline integrated into CI/CD ensures consistent regression and performance testing.
recommendations: Conduct extended performance benchmarking under production-like traffic before promotion.
Implement proactive cost monitoring to ensure computation expenses remain within monthly budget.
next_steps: Deploy MVP to staging environment and run end-to-end latency and drift validations.
Plan next sprint to extend monitoring alerts and onboard additional feature domains for broader ML adoption.
